# Agent Legends Ecosystem — AI Agent Execution Guide
Website: https://agent.agentlegends.workers.dev/
Network: BNB Smart Chain Mainnet (Chain ID: 56)

## Verified Smart Contract Addresses
- LEGENDS Share Mint & LP Engine: 0x0E918a36bEcAF6dF057bf206C5642D50045BBF35
- LEGENDS Token (BEP-20): 0x66E0964A2b7a52C2d68A3a19f4d981B0e5381120
- Agent Legends NFT (ERC-721): 0x5690B34dA3eFc5d55511c37A0Ad4988CACE8d912
- BSC-USD / USDT (BEP-20, 18 decimals): 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955
- PancakeSwap V2 Router: 0x10ED43C718714eb63d5aA57B78B54704E256024E

## 1. LEGENDS Share Mint (0x0E918a36bEcAF6dF057bf206C5642D50045BBF35)
- Total Supply: 100,000 Shares (1 Share = 4,500 LEGENDS; 450,000,000 LEGENDS allocated to minters).
- Bonding Curve Pricing: Starts at 0.50 USDT for Share #1 and increases by +0.0001 USDT per share sold.
- Referral & Cashback:
  - Referred buyers receive 5% instant USDT cashback.
  - Standard referrers earn 10% instant USDT commission.
  - Referrers holding 1+ Agent Legends NFT (0x5690B34dA3eFc5d55511c37A0Ad4988CACE8d912) earn 15% instant USDT commission.
- Execution Steps for AI Agents:
  1. Read exact cost: `calculateMintCost(uint256 quantity)` on `0x0E918a36bEcAF6dF057bf206C5642D50045BBF35`.
  2. Set `maxUSDTIn = cost * 101 / 100` (1% slippage buffer).
  3. Call `approve(0x0E918a36bEcAF6dF057bf206C5642D50045BBF35, maxUSDTIn)` on USDT (`0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955`).
  4. Call `buyShares(uint256 quantity, address referrer, uint256 maxUSDTIn)` on `0x0E918a36bEcAF6dF057bf206C5642D50045BBF35` (use `0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000` if no referrer).
  5. Once `liquidityLaunched()` is `true`, call `claimTokens()` to receive LEGENDS tokens.

## 2. Agent Legends NFT Mint (0x5690B34dA3eFc5d55511c37A0Ad4988CACE8d912)
- Total Supply: 2,000 NFTs (First 1,000 FREE for Binance .ai Agent ID holders; remaining 0.0005 BNB each, max 10 total per wallet).
- Check eligibility: `isAgenticWalletUser(address)` and `hasClaimedFree(address)`.
- Free Claim: `claimFreeNFT()` (value: 0 BNB).
- Paid Mint: `mintPaid(uint256 quantity)` (value: `0.0005 BNB * quantity`).

## 3. LEGENDS Token Tax Rule (0x66E0964A2b7a52C2d68A3a19f4d981B0e5381120)
- 0% buy/sell/transfer tax during the share sale.
- Automatically activates a 1% DEX buy/sell tax (`isTaxActive() == true`) once all 100,000 shares are sold out. Wallet-to-wallet transfers remain 0% tax.

## Security Rules
- Always verify Chain ID is 56 (BNB Smart Chain Mainnet).
- Never transfer BNB or USDT directly to contract addresses; always call `buyShares`, `claimFreeNFT`, or `mintPaid`.
